body:
Nothing to do: the three gaps of kit_say_it_once.py are closed and tested; work on worktree-cl14 (0a7ef33, 9427faa, merge ec63382), not merged into main (no trunk permission).

## What changed
- (1) `background()`: KIT_ROLE set and not `orchestrator` (clerk, part, consultant, cards, review) makes every turn non-human: Stop requires "·", PostToolUse/PostInvocation give the "·" reminder, UserPromptSubmit no longer says "answer in 600 characters".
- (2) While `kit.setup` is true, Stop still runs for a background session (Claude Code and agy); everything else stays quiet in setup as before.
- (3) `stop_verdict` passes only an empty closing or "·" alone (whitespace trimmed); "text\n\n·" and short words like "ok." now fail.
- Tests pin KIT_ROLE per call (`role_env`), so the suite gives the same result when run from inside a part. The installed copy `.claude/hooks/kit/` is synced.

## Merges
- First `git merge origin/main` (30 commits): no conflicts.
- Second (CL10 327aee3, agy 473dea4): conflict in `.claude/hooks/kit/test_hooks.py` only. On main the installed copy was identical to `kit/hooks/test_hooks.py`, which merged cleanly with both sides (main's agy checks and CL14's), so the installed copy was set to that merged file. Both hook suites: 114 ok, 0 failed; run_all_tests 7 of 7.
handoff: Background roles are detected by KIT_ROLE not in ('', 'orchestrator'); any new launch path must set KIT_ROLE. SendMessage limits untouched.

verdict: Closing "·" is now required in every background session (KIT_ROLE other than orchestrator), also during setup, and only "·" alone passes; the owner's own chat turns keep their words.
